`resistor.step` is KiCad's `Resistor_SMD.3dshapes/R_MELF_MMB-0207.step`,
from the standard KiCad 10.0.3 library installed on macOS. Its original
STEP attribution is retained. Used to exercise the real OCCT WASM converter
under the desktop application's restriction on JavaScript string compilation.

Source: https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-packages3D
